items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I wanted to get the names of some of these fellas straight. We were talking to Kid Thomas' daddy and he mentioned a lot of people. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, he used to play in the Pickwick band.

ctx.x: I don't know if it's slide trombone. Something about slide trombone. Well, we played that too after the showboat came out here with that voice. And the Pickwick band liked it so much, so they said, I've got a trombone here, so I've trombone.
I wanted to get the names of some of these fellas straight. We were talking to Kid Thomas' daddy and he mentioned a lot of people.
Well, he used to play in the Pickwick band. Well, Mr. Joe Stewart played the bass, and I know some of the members of the Pickwick band.
